_comment: GENERATED by tools/era_solver.mjs. The mod's five-era balance: the price every good carries in each era (% of base), and the production methods a country of that era actually runs. Prices are SOLVED, not chosen: raw goods from the extraction/agriculture profit target, manufactured goods from the obsolescence rule, secondary-PM goods from their own marginal economics. See the file header of tools/era_solver.mjs for why the system is determined.
